name: Assuric
description: Assuric MCP allows you to interact with your organisation's regulatory compliance posture. Try asking Claude questions about your hazard log, policies, training status, evidence catalogue and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Assuric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Assuric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.assuric.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Assuric MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Assuric lists 18 MCP tools, including describe_control_evidence, describe_document_catalog, describe_hazard_log, describe_records, get_cause_with_related, get_control_with_related, get_hazard_with_related, get_record, list_document_versions, list_org_context, load_org_context_items, and query_control_evidence.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Assuric?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Assuric in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Assuric requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Assuric is developed by Assuric. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
